divergences.description: CheckSessionUseCase handles a checkSession() AuthInvalidFailure by clearing storage and returning unauthenticated. The plan (T044, contracts pseudocode) says every failure other than AuthExpiredFailure must produce a network-error SessionStatus.

SessionRepositoryImpl.refresh() does not just persist the session and return it. It writes the tokens to storage directly, then makes a second backend call to auth-session to recover the Account, because the auth-refresh response has no user object. The plan expects refresh() to call persist() and return the Session, with no extra auth-session call.

T056 says a second AuthExpiredDetected arriving while the state is already expiredRenewable re-emits expiredRenewable. The implementation returns early and emits nothing, and the test asserts that no state is emitted.

Nothing in the app ever dispatches AuthExpiredDetected. ApiClient and the repositories return AuthExpiredFailure but never notify SessionBloc, so an expired session during active use never raises the overlay (FR-013, T056/T057). Also, SessionBloc is never moved out of expiredRenewable after a successful re-authentication, so the early-return guard blocks every later expiry.

T026 calls for a generic retry affordance keyed off `retryable`. The login/sign-up page shows only a text message for each failure. There is no retry action tied to `retryable`, even though the network message tells the user to tap to retry.
A Dio LogInterceptor that logs full request and response bodies was added in debug builds; it is not in the plan. These bodies include passwords and tokens.
T069 (restrict ios/Runner/Info.plist to portrait only) is marked done, but the diff contains no Info.plist change. Portrait is enforced only at the Dart level through SystemChrome.
